# Best Computer Hub

> Best Computer Hub (Best Computer Hub Ltd) is a technology retailer and IT solutions provider in Bangladesh (established 2024), offering authentic laptops, desktop and gaming PCs, computer components, monitors, printers, enterprise and home networking equipment, surveillance systems, smart TVs, eReaders, and gadgets with nationwide delivery across all 64 districts.

- **Website**: https://bestcomputerhub.com/
- **Customer Support Email**: support@bestcomputerhub.com
- **Phone / Hotline**: (+880) 1794062601, (+880) 1783553844, (+880) 1714111479 (Repair Hub phone hours: 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM)
- **Office Address**: 74/1 (1st Floor), Rajonigondha Bhaban, Science Laboratory Road, Dhanmondi, Dhaka 1205, Bangladesh
- **Repair Hub Address**: GM Plaza, Level-1, 93 New Elephant Road, Dhaka-1205, Bangladesh
- **Business Registration**: Trade License TRAD/DSCC/034174/2023 | TIN 645229471858 | VAT BIN 006098335-0201 | Member of Dhaka Chamber of Commerce & Industry (DCCI)
- **Payment Options**: Cash on Delivery (selected areas), bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Bank Transfer, Visa, and Mastercard; Credit Card EMI via SSLCOMMERZ for eligible orders of BDT 5,000 and above (up to 36 months depending on participating bank)

## Product Categories

### Primary Navigation Categories

- [Brand Laptop & PC](https://bestcomputerhub.com/product-category/brand-laptop-pc/): Laptops, Desktop PCs, All-in-One PCs, Mini PCs, and official accessories.
- [Gaming Component](https://bestcomputerhub.com/product-category/gaming-component/): Gaming laptops, gaming desktop components, gaming peripherals, and sound systems.
- [PC Component](https://bestcomputerhub.com/product-category/pc-component/): Processors, motherboards, graphics cards, monitors, desktop/laptop RAM, SSDs, hard drives, power supplies, casings, coolers, keyboards, mice, UPS & IPS, and office equipment.
- [Networking Component](https://bestcomputerhub.com/product-category/networking-component/): Wi-Fi routers, broadband routers, managed and PoE switches, access points, firewalls, OLTs/ONUs, fiber optics, and passive networking accessories.
- [Surveillance & Security](https://bestcomputerhub.com/product-category/surveillance-security/): CCTV and IP cameras, DVR/NVR/XVR recorders, access control systems, home security, and digital lockers.
- [Server, Storage & Software](https://bestcomputerhub.com/product-category/server-storage/): Enterprise servers, server racks, NAS/SAN storage, cloud and backup solutions, licensed operating systems, office suites, and antivirus software.
- [Gadget](https://bestcomputerhub.com/product-category/gadget/): Smartphones and tablets, smart watches, earbuds, headphones, power banks, drones, E Ink eReaders, portable power stations, solar panels/inverters, and content creator gear.
- [Smart Home Appliance](https://bestcomputerhub.com/product-category/smart-home-appliance/): Smart TVs, air conditioners, smart home IoT devices, voice assistants, smart displays, rechargeable fans, and air humidifiers.
- [Convenience Hub](https://bestcomputerhub.com/product-category/convenience-hub/): Healthcare, grooming, kids zone, pet zone, vehicle, and lifestyle electronics.

- [Warranty Policy](https://bestcomputerhub.com/warranty-policy/): Manufacturer/brand warranty handling, invoice requirements, 7–15 working day standard turnaround (longer if imported parts are needed), and warranty exclusions.

- [Delivery Policy](https://bestcomputerhub.com/delivery-policy/): Nationwide delivery terms across Bangladesh, 1–3 working day typical delivery timeframe, Cash on Delivery rules, and outside-Dhaka courier terms.
